answer: Non-parallelizable epoch cliffs resist sybils: each consequential power unlocks only after a fixed count of epochs of unbroken standing — a cliff that real wall-clock time, not compute, must cross. An attacker spawns a thousand fakes in an instant, but each still waits the same span before it matters; time cannot be bought or parallelized. A hollow stand of fresh fakes bends like willow in wind yet gains nothing through the window, and each must survive every audit or reset to zero. Honest agents cross once and keep their velvet-worn standing — count is instant, tenure is not.
